1. On account of withdrawal of appearance of the then Counsel appearing for the petitioners,
advocate notice was sent to the petitioners on 02.02.2026 by ordinary post.

sentences.text: The dispute in the present petition is about the acquisition of the lands in question for the purposes of Gujarat Industrial Development Corporation (GIDC).

The prayer in NEUTRAL CITATION C/SCA/2379/2016 ORDER DATED: 06/03/2026 undefined the writ petition is to restrain the respondents, their agents and servants from disturbing the possession of the petitioners over the land in question.

3. A perusal of the order-sheet indicates that the writ petition was entertained by dated 18.02.2016 on the submission made by the learned Counsel for the petitioners about the applicability of Section 24(2) of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: There is no interim order operating in favour of the petitioners.

4. Mr. R.D. Dave, learned advocate appearing for the respondent - GIDC would submit that the lands in question have already been utilized for the purpose of GIDC and have been allotted to the eligible persons.
5. We may also note from the order-sheet that the present writ petition was dismissed for non prosecution by order dated 25.07.2017 and seems to have been restored later.
6. Be that as it may, it seems that the petitioners have lost interest in the matter.
The present petition is dismissed accordingly, for want of prosecution.
